en: Sepia-toned historic view of a European riverside city. In the foreground is a river with moored wooden bathhouses or barges and a metal truss bridge crossing the water. Along the riverbank stands a row of multi‑story buildings with steep roofs; a tall church tower with an onion dome and clock rises prominently from the town. On the hillside behind the town are terraced paths and a large fortress complex on top of the hill, as well as a separate clock tower structure on the slope. The scene is framed like a classic early 20th‑century city postcard.
